notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0
notes.notes:
Inflamed Games is your new publisher and developer for the Proficient Paddles series on Steam. We've taken our time to present a new update for our Steam audiences, feel free to visit our website www.inflamedgames.com and follow our social channels for all future information on us and Proficient Paddles!

General Updates:

 Removed references and assets connected to the previous publisher.
 Fixed the news tile's ability to source data.
 Re-enabled the Unity Application Configurator (Display Resolution Dialog).


UI:

 Updated the controller, keyboard and mouse button prompt icons.


Audio:

 The game’s music audio mix has been updated.
